system.description:
Deal [(SR+1)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target.

(Extra): Secondary targets within a range of [Target: Area (P) / Range: Close] centered on the initial target take [DEX Mod] direct damage. This damage triggers [Weakness] on the secondary target, as if they had failed their [Dodge Check].

A special skill that envelops an arrow in lightning and shoots it. When hit, lightning bursts like a spider's web and attacks the surroundings.
